objective: Evaluate harness v3 against the adopted v2 rig on the standing real-gold gate: v3 mirrors the suite repetition metric inside verify_layers, adds register-aware count anchors, and declares detector trust so anchors cannot mislead on detector-failure pages. The baseline lane's submission reader was also made first-wins tolerant after two observed duplicate-attempt flakes.
hypothesis: v3 eliminates case-level repetition on the two dense Gaoli commentary pages without regressing healthy pages, holding or improving the paired MTHv2 mean against v2; on passing, the AncientDoc smoke confirms no cross-suite regression.
harness_changes_from_v2: verify_layers reports repetition per layer with the exact suite semantics: fraction of nonblank lines appearing three or more times, with the offending loops named
detections split into horizontal registers (y-gap over 1.8x median box height) before column clustering; columns carry their register and crops are named rRcNN
verify_layers computes detector_trusted from combined draft length against detected boxes (in [0.6, 1.6] and at least 40 boxes) and suppresses column flags when untrusted
shared contract repair outside v3: transcribe_omp and the v2 layered reader now accept a sealed first submission when later duplicate attempts were rejected, with the pinned test updated deliberately

candidates.pairing_note: The decision pair is v3 versus the adopted v2 champion, so the paired delta measures the v3 harness changes alone; both sides stage second readers.

execution.smoke_design: The two measured repetition pages, the best healthy page for non-regression, and one TKH control.
execution.policy: Smoke first. Start the full MTHv2 24 only if all four v3 sessions seal, v3 case-level repetition is zero on both Gaoli pages, and the healthy control does not regress by more than 0.03. Run the AncientDoc four-case smoke after the full MTHv2 run for cross-suite non-regression.

gates.repetition_binding: v3 case-level repetition_rate is 0.0 on both Gaoli pages
gates.healthy_non_regression: v3 CER on the healthy control within +0.03 of v2
gates.full_quality: v3 MTHv2 paired mean at or below v2's with no corpus slice regressing beyond suite policy
gates.cross_suite: v3 AncientDoc smoke mean within +0.03 of v2 on the same four cases
gates.budget_stop: bench run --max-cost aborts dispatch at the ceiling

allowed_changes: library/evaluations/runs (run records produced by bench run)
non_goals: Do not run bench propose or promote.
Do not modify the exodia campaign loop or partition.
next_permitted_action: Run the targeted four-case MTHv2 smoke, evaluate the repetition-binding and non-regression gates, then the full 24 and the AncientDoc cross-suite smoke only as the gates allow.
